method: Read actual saved ZIP members and matching-version Python code objects as data; no client module imports.
Decode serialized protobuf descriptors; inspect native PE instructions and referenced literal/type data.
Hash archives, selected members and native dependencies; preserve exact branch differences and duplicate archive identities.
Compare packaged requirements with the current server implementation and deployment/transport settings.

validationBoundary.meaning: Static requirements verification only; no assertion of runtime activation or end-to-end acceptance.
validationBoundary.scope: Static requirements-audit snapshot before the implementation update below.

serverRequirements.walletBootstrapGap: Resolved by the implemented account/character-scoped bootstrap, balance and recovery adapters. End-to-end testing remains deferred.
serverRequirements.buildSelection: Select the exact Frontier profile and matching synchronized Sui world/static artifacts. Bootstrap and assembly synchronization use the resolved build. Export EVEJS_CLIENT_BUILD for external launch and synchronization tooling as well.

suiTransport.configuration: Current transports fix these endpoints; Docker container networking must make them reachable in the server network namespace.

serverRequirements.worldConfiguration: EVEJS_SUI_WORLD_CONFIG_PATH or _local/frontier-world/<build>/world.private.json; ready world-sync-v1, matching Localnet chain/package/registry/admin authority plus current deployment artifacts and required assembly configuration.
serverRequirements.relayTransportIdentity: Existing single-account loopback resolver must match an authenticated live game session; claimed character IDs or Docker port forwarding alone do not provide that identity.
serverRequirements.dockerCompose: Stock compose.yaml does not define the Sui node, world deployment mounts or the above build/world environment values.

early.method: Read-only ZIP and native-file hashes; .pyj zlib decompression; Python 2.7 code objects parsed and disassembled using xdis, never imported or executed. Serialized protobuf descriptor constants parsed as data. No tests, live client, helper DLL or chain executed.

archive.duplicateSelection: Last archive occurrence (ZipFile.read(name)); all occurrences hashed below if selected.

blockers: Current bridge consumes ERC2771 signatures; this client consumes session-based proxy APIs and has no matching public MetaTransactionRequest.
Proxy signer, key storage, contract ABI/state and authentication behavior require separate implementation/evidence.
Old tokenMgr/blockchain depot inventory/caller semantics and notices need translation to Sui.
unknown: Exact proxy signature scheme and EIP712 schema
Runtime activation and live state compatibility

protocol.basis: ERC20 broker stubs expose erc20_balance_of/erc20_transfer, native token and ABI contract read/write via external blockchain proxy; EVM classification is supported, but no local EIP712/forwarder signing is established.

wallet.mode: externally managed proxy account, keyed by character/anima ID
wallet.password: User-supplied password passed to proxy create/unlock/recovery/key export APIs. Client UI shows mnemonic/private key; proxy storage and signer implementation are not bundled in audited archive.

symbols.name: <module>.JsonRpcClient.call_method_on_blockchain_proxy
constants: The JSON-RPC response is invalid (contains no "error" or "result")

archive.duplicateSelection: Last archive occurrence (ZipFile.read(name)); all occurrences hashed below if selected.

blockers: Old cfg JSON-string shape and config entry indexing need version-specific configuration.
Wallet initialization requires SmartCharacterExistsRequest and create_smart_character RPC, plus encryption/recovery methods.
Storage/anchor/fuel use older smartDeployableService routes and payloads rather than modern public prepare/execute.
unknown: Contract deployment ABI/address values and eip712 domain name/version are external configuration inputs.
Runtime activation, native loading on target platform, and end-to-end Sui conversion remain untested.

browserWallet.fallback: Other eth_* methods POST directly to config[1].urls.public[0]. eth_sendTransaction signs locally then sends eth_sendRawTransaction to that URL. This requires actual EVM JSON-RPC behavior for browser dapps and is not supplied by a lifecycle-only bridge.

configuration.itemHashQuirk: _chain_item_id uses hardcoded item:devnet-<item_id or type_id>, unlike tenant-configurable smart objects.
configuration.publicChainUrl: Parsed native config entry index 1, urls.public[0]; chain_id also from entry index 1.
configuration.rawConfig: cfg must be native JSON string (passed directly to ContractMgr(config=...), not modern parsed list. system_ids maps function names to bytes32 system IDs.
configuration.tenant: monolithconfig chainTenant, default devnet; not get_chain_tenant RPC.

protocol.signing: Native ECDSA typed-data signer (WalletAccountSignTypedData), ERC2771Forwarder template, IWorld.callFrom(delegator,systemId,callData).

requests.lifecycle: Client SmartStorageUnitSvc online/offline builds signed EIP712 call and sends public MetaTransactionRequest.

wallet.recovery: encrypt_recovery(char_id,mnemonic); decrypt_recovery(char_id,ciphertext); client has __plaintextfallback__ marker if encryption returns false.
wallet.setup: Session change queries SmartCharacterExistsRequest(char_id) and branches to creation/recovery.

nativeSigningSchema.method: PE symbol lookup and objdump disassembly; trace Go typed-data array string-pointer/length stores; resolve .rdata literals by PE section mapping. Native code is never executed.

erc2771.method: Read-only ZIP/marshal/protobuf inspection plus static PE symbol and machine-instruction/rodata inspection. No client code imported/executed, no native signer or chain operation, no tests. Exact CPython3.12 instructions decoded by a non-executing marshal reader.

domainConfiguration.chainIdWireRepresentation: Shipped2973163 template emits hex string0x7a69 for31337; all3 audited2973163/2997426/3122254 binaries are byte-identical. Hex must be canonicalized without changing numeric meaning.
domainConfiguration.source: cfg ERC2771Forwarder entry eip712.name,eip712.version; chain_id,deployed_to supply chainID and verifyingContract.
domainConfiguration.validationLimit: No new native template/signature experiments executed in this audit.

nativeSigningSchema.verification: Static stores in MetaTransactionTemplate confirmed on each of three unique shipped native binaries; does not prove every other native behavior equivalent.

Client _check_char_exists must successfully receive an authoritative SmartCharacterExistsResponse; configuration and sender binding alone do not enable its _has_smart_char flag.
When a chain character is absent, client creation signs createCharacter and calls encryptionWalletService.create_smart_character before lifecycle actions can be signed.
The callFrom delegation, system IDs, ABI parameter names and smart-object ID mapping must fit the exact branch.
The server relay only handles audited lifecycle intents; native storage/fuel/anchor, balances, character onboarding and recovery need their separate authority/translation implementations.

sharedRequirements.lifecycleFlow: SmartAssemblySvc._online/_offline -> encryptedWallet.online_meta_tx/offline_meta_tx -> locally packed/signed EIP712 -> PublicGatewayClient.send_meta_tx(meta_tx,signature) -> ERC2771 wrapper
sharedRequirements.recovery: All12 clients use local wallet and locally persisted recovery; no encryptionWalletService.encrypt_recovery or decrypt_recovery consumed in these12 CPython3.12 branches. Build3122254 additionally calls public key recovery requests.
sharedRequirements.serverGap: Lifecycle relay implementation is not a complete unchanged-client onboarding implementation. SmartCharacterExists, conditional create_smart_character and balance/recovery paths must be separately implemented or known-good existing state established before claiming full conversion.

sui.method: Data-only ZIP inventory + matching CPython 3.12 marshal/code-object disassembly and serialized protobuf descriptor inspection. No client code imported or executed; no native libraries, signer processes, network calls, tests or transactions run.
sui.scope: Five catalogued Sui-consuming builds only:3366068,3388875,3551616,3572727,3640684. Manual3502403 excluded.

serverEvidence.scope: build-specific world.private.json; deployment/chain IDs; owner signer and character verification
buildAssemblyTransitionTransactionData no-op Sui snapshot; isValidAssemblyTransitionSignature shape check; native lifecycle intent path
Official auth delegation and per-build economy feature gate

strings: Failed to get wallet provider JavaScript

globalConfiguration.browserChain: SuiWalletProvider injects window.WALLET_API_CHAIN = "sui:" + network_address; exposes window.callWallet RPC.

sui_chain_id.finding: No getter or literal named sui_chain_id occurs in the inspected wallet/signer/assembly consumer modules. Network is passed to signer as network; this is a scoped absence finding, not a claim about executable internals.

web3_api_gateway_url.currentServer: No dedicated default override found; runtime global config overrides may supply one.

localDevelopment.addressCheck: connect().accounts[0].suiAddress must equal generated/reused wallet address.
localDevelopment.serverMatch: Current server derives local development Sui address from SHA512("dev:"+accountId), so account ID, tenant and selected client key must agree.
localDevelopment.storedKey: settings.user.ui key sui_signer_key_pair_v1 takes precedence over generating a deterministic seed key. Stored unrelated keys can differ from the server-derived address.
localDevelopment.token: fabricate_local_dev_user_token(tenant=lower(prefs.clusterName),user_id=session.userid); native genKeyPair/useKeyPair receive token and apiGatewayUrl.

moveDeployment.clientFinding: Inspected wallet/assembly Python consumers sign server-provided transactions; no specific Move package/registry/RPC URL is hardcoded in those selected modules. Binary signer internals were not executed.
moveDeployment.limits: Shared client signing interface does not establish Move ABI compatibility, chain activation or end-to-end support for another build.
serverRequirements: Ready world-sync config matching exact EVEJS_CLIENT_BUILD and network localnet
Live chainId, world packageId, objectRegistryId, adminAclId and published energy/fuel configs must match synchronization evidence
Build-specific static catalog/energy manifest and on-chain Character owner/address must agree; tenant defaults dev
World/industry/access deployments, signing authority, gas funds and durable journals required for corresponding server operations

flow: SignerClient.connect() then Reported(wallet_address.hex) public gateway event
officialZkLogin.issuerRequirement: A valid issuer-backed JWT bound to the requested nonce and a compatible proof/salt/address authority are required. Issuer URL and direct Enoki HTTP endpoint are not hardcoded in inspected Python consumers; calls use the named public-gateway requests and native apiGatewayUrl.
officialZkLogin.serverBlocker: frontierEconomyGatewayService only delegates to context.frontierOfficialAuthProvider; without a real provider it fails OFFICIAL_AUTH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE. It does not generate JWT/proofs. The economy handler is enabled only for3640684.

transactions.fuel: PrepareDepositFuel/PrepareWithdrawFuel return prepared_transaction_bcs_data and prepared_transaction_uuid; wallet signs prepared BCS base64 then execute passes UUID+signature.
transactions.nativeLifecycle: set_online/set_offline/link_gates/unlink_gate/gate_jump ask smartAssemblyService for transaction_data+transaction_uuid, sign transaction_data with Sui wallet, then submit corresponding *_signature callback.
transactions.provider: CEF extension forwards JSON-RPC method/params to native signer; exact native implementation compatibility was not executed or inferred from binary hashes.
transactions.storage: PrepareDepositItems/PrepareWithdrawItems yield prepared_transaction_attributes.bcs_data_b64_bytes (string); execute passes prepared_transaction.uuid (bytes) and signature (string).
transactions.tokenExchange: PrepareTokenToLUXResponse.unsigned_transaction bytes are decoded UTF8 before sign_transaction; execute uses operation_id+signature.

sui.testing: Deferred at user request. No tests, native/client execution, signer processes, network calls or chain transactions were performed for this audit.

implementationUpdate.scope: Wallet bootstrap, online/offline adapters and automatic initial world setup/synchronization for every catalogued EVM build; runtime testing deferred by user.
implemented: Exact branch config shapes, system ID lookup, lifecycle argument names, object-ID hashing and createCharacter tuple ABIs
SmartCharacterExistsRequest backed by live confirmed Sui Character/PlayerProfile plus verified EVM enrollment
Legacy TokenBalanceRequest and proxy balance routes with exact source-to-18-decimal unit translation
2615573 server-encrypted mnemonic recovery and3122254 account/character-scoped encrypted recovery upload/retrieval
2455427 authenticated JSON-RPC proxy, password-protected mnemonic custody, bootstrap and SSU online/offline
Guarded2455427 proxy-host staging tool, not executed
Fresh authorization immediately before first or resumed Sui transaction submission
Initial Windows setup and world up/restart/sync automatically prepare per-build EVM-to-Sui manifests without replacing recovery secrets, existing account pins, passphrases or manual mapping policies
Authenticated character-scoped random wallet passphrases encrypted at rest, with exact-build object-ID resolution against owned runtime assemblies
Automatic launcher/profile selection and synchronized manifest discovery, preserving explicit and custom manifest paths
EVM-only deployed energy source-build provenance and verified client catalog subsets without zero-cost fallback for missing requirements
deferred: Tests, native/client execution, staging execution and live Sui transactions
Non-lifecycle gameplay adapters including storage, fuel, anchoring, gates and token exchange/purchases
Arbitrary Ethereum dapp/JSON-RPC contract execution and historic EVM contract/balance migration
